### Meaning
| infl. | class | meaning   |

| ~     | *n.*  | self, ego |
### Implied meaning
- auto- (as in "automatic")
- private, personal, intimate
### Etymology
#### Glyph
- 厶
- sitelen pona "sipi"

both of these show something going from itself back to itself; a thread looping back to itself
#### Sound
- Maltese "jien"
- *a priori:* in=inner/mental
